shortDescription: This module manages security options on IBM Storage Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: checkpasswordhistory
options.description: Specifies whether the system prevents the user from reusing a previous password.

options.name: clitimeout
options.description: Specifies the amount of time (in minutes) in range 5 - 240 before a session expires and the user is logged out of the CLI for inactivity.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize storage system.

options.name: disablesuperusercim
options.description: Specifies whether CIMOM access must be disabled for the superuser.

options.name: disablesuperusergui
options.description: Specifies whether GUI access must be disabled for the superuser.

options.name: disablesuperuserrest
options.description: Specifies whether REST API access must be disabled for the superuser.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: expirywarning
options.description: Specifies the number of days in range 0 -30 before a password expires to raise a warning. The warning is displayed on every CLI login until the password is changed. A value of 0 means that the feature is disabled and warnings are not displayed.

options.name: guitimeout
options.description: Specifies the amount of time (in minutes) in range 5 - 240 before a session expires and the user is logged out of the GUI for inactivity.

options.name: lockoutperiod
options.description: Specifies the number of minutes in range 0 - 10080 that a user is locked out for if the max failed logins value is reached. A value of 0 implies the user is indefinitely locked out when the max failed login attempts are reached.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: maxfailedlogins
options.description: Specifies the number of failed login attempts in range 0 -10 before the user account is locked for the amount of time that is specified in lockout period. A value of 0 means that the feature is disabled and accounts are not locked out after failed login attempts.

options.name: maxpasswordhistory
options.description: Specifies the number of previous passwords in range 0 - 10 to compare with if checkpasswordhistory is enabled. A value of 0 means that the new password is compared with the current password only.

options.name: minpasswordage
options.description: Specifies the minimum number of days between password changes in range 0 -365. This setting is enforced if checkpasswordhistory is enabled. This restriction is ignored if the password is expired. The setting does nothing if the value is greater than the passwordexpiry value.

options.name: minpasswordlength
options.description: Specifies the minimum length requirement in range 6 -64 for user account passwords on the system.

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: passworddigits
options.description: Specifies mimimum number of digits in range 0 -3 required in passwords for local users.

options.name: passwordexpiry
options.description: Specifies the number of days in range 0 - 365 before a password expires. A value of 0 means the feature is disabled and passwords do not expire.

options.name: passwordlowercase
options.description: Specifies number of minimum lowercase characters in range 0 - 3 required in passwords for local users.

options.name: passwordspecialchars
options.description: Specifies number of minimum required special characters in range 0 - 3 in passwords for local users.

options.name: passworduppercase
options.description: Specifies number of minimum uppercase characters in range 0 - 3 in passwords for local users.

options.name: patchautoupdate
options.description: Enables or disables the patch auto updater service.

options.name: resetsshprotocol
options.description: Resets the SSH protocol security level to the default value 3 and configures the system to automatically follow the suggested level.

options.name: restapitimeout
options.description: Specifies token expiry time in minutes in the range 10 - 120.

options.name: sshgracetime
options.description: Specifies the duration of time in seconds in range 15-1800, a user has to enter login factors per SSH connection before the connection is terminated.

options.name: sshmaxtries
options.description: Specifies the amount of allowed login attempts (in range 1-10) per a single SSH connection.

options.name: sshprotocol
options.description: Specifies the numeric value for the SSH security level setting in range 1 - 4. The level 1 Allows the following key exchange methods curve25519-sha256 curve25519-sha256@libssh.org ecdh-sha2-nistp256 ecdh-sha2-nistp384 ecdh-sha2-nistp521 diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha256 diffie-hellman-group16-sha512 diffie-hellman-group18-sha512 diffie-hellman-group14-sha256 diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 diffie-hellman-group1-sha1 diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1 The level 2 Allows the following key exchange

options.name: superuserlocking
options.description: Specifies whether the locking policy configured on the system also applies to the superuser. The value is either enable or disable. This parameter is only supported on systems with a dedicated technician port.

options.name: superusermultifactor
options.description: Specifies whether the superuser should be prompted for multifactor authentication.

options.name: superuserpasswordkeyrequired
options.description: Specifies whether the superuser must provide both a password and SSH key for authentication.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize storage system. To generate a token, use the ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize storage system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validates certification.
